question: Should OpenClaw adopt `channels.msteams.accounts` and `channels.msteams.defaultAccount` as the supported long-term contract for running multiple Teams bot identities in one gateway?
rationale: The code and proof support the feature, but accepting new public config, setup, credential, and persistent-state semantics is a durable product and compatibility commitment that automation cannot authorize.

options.title: Sponsor the account contract
options.body: Reopen or adopt the PR, confirm the inheritance and legacy-upgrade rules, and require a real legacy-config upgrade smoke before landing.

options.title: Defer multi-bot support
options.body: Keep the canonical feature request open for future sponsorship while closing this implementation branch without treating its technical work as rejected.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the account contract
recommendation.body: Reopen or adopt the PR, confirm the inheritance and legacy-upgrade rules, and require a real legacy-config upgrade smoke before landing.
